data.name: Kasam
data.gender_notes: Kasam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who keeps his promise, trustworthy. The name Kasam carries the meaning “Promise, Commitment” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Kasam usually hope their child will grow to embody promise, commitment and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Kasam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Promise, Commitment.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kasam total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: كسام
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم كسام مشتق من كلمة القسمة أو الحلف بالله، وهو يعني الشخص الذي يحلف أو يقسم على شيء ما، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا اللَّهَ عَلى أَيْمَانِكُمْ حِجَّةً' (البقرة: ۲۲۶)، حيث يتحدث عن الحلف بالله وكيفية التعامل معها، ويحمل هذا الاسم في طياته معاني الالتزام والتعهد والضمان.

in_urdu.name: کسام
in_urdu.meaning: قسم لینے والا یا حلف کھانے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام کسام عربی زبان کی اصطلاح القسم یا حلف سے ماخوذ ہے، جو شخص حلف کھاتا ہے یا کسی چیز پر قسم کھاتا ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے۔ یہ لفظ قرآن کریم میں کئی جگہوں پر آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ البقرة میں: 'وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا اللَّهَ عَلى أَيْمَانِكُمْ حِجَّةً' (البقرة: ۲۲۶)، جہاں یہ حلف اٹھانے اور اس کے ساتھ نمٹنے کے طریقے کے بارے میں بات کرتا ہے، اور یہ نام لینے والے کے لیے پابندی، عہد اور ضمانت کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: کسام
in_hindi.meaning: قسم खाने वाला या हलफ खाने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम कसम арабी भाषा की शब्दावली قسم या हलफ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है व्यक्ति जो हलफ खाता है या किसी चीज़ की कसम खाता है। यह शब्द कुरआन में कई स्थानों पर आया है, जैसे सूरह अल-बक़राह में: 'وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا اللَّهَ عَلى أَيْمَانِكُمْ حِجَّةً' (البقرة: ۲۲۶), जहां यह हलफ उठाने और उसके साथ व्यवहार करने के तरीके के बारे में बात करता है, और यह नाम लेने वाले के लिए प्रतिबंध, वचन और गारंटी के अर्थ रखता है।

in_pashto.name: کسام
in_pashto.long_meaning: د کسام نوم د عربي ژبې د قسمة یا حلف کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د هغه چا معنی لري چې حلف خوري یا د کوم شی پر سر قسم خوري. دا کلمه د قرآن کریم په ډیرو ځایونو کې راغلې ده، لکه د بقره سوره کې: 'وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا اللَّهَ عَلى أَيْمَانِكُمْ حِجَّةً' (البقرة: ۲۲۶)، چیرته چې دا د حلف خوړلو او ورسره چلند کولو طریقه راپه ګوته کوي، او د اخیستونکي لپاره د پابندۍ، ژمنې او تضمین معنی لري.

in_english.name: Kasam
in_english.meaning: One who takes an oath or makes a pledge
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kasam is derived from the Arabic root 'q-s-m' which relates to taking an oath or making a pledge. In Islamic context, this name signifies someone who is trustworthy, reliable, and committed. The term 'Kasam' appears in the Quran in various forms related to oaths and covenants, emphasizing the importance of fulfilling one's promises and commitments. Historically, this name has been used across Muslim cultures to denote individuals known for their integrity and adherence to their words.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kasam" carries a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world. In Arabic culture, keeping one's word and being trustworthy is highly valued. In fact, it is a fundamental principle of Islamic ethics. The name serves as a reminder of this cultural expectation and instills a sense of responsibility and integrity in the child or individual bearing the name. It also reflects the importance of building strong relationships and maintaining trust in communities and between individuals.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Kasam" has profound significance in Islamic theology. In Islamic tradition, Allah (God) is referred to as the "Kasim Al-Wa'id" (the Guardian of Promises). The Prophet Mohammad (peace be upon him) was also known for being a man of his word and was referred to as "Siddiq," meaning truthful. Therefore, by naming someone "Kasam," it is a reminder of the spiritual qualities of trustworthiness, reliability, and adherence to truth, which are essential in the relationship between the individual and their Creator. The name serves as an inspiration to strive for these qualities in one's daily life and in one's interactions with others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Promise, Commitment" symbolizes One who keeps his promise, trustworthy. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Kasam serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of promise, commitment.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Kasam' in the Islamic tradition signifies a solemn pledge or promise, often used in religious contexts such as marriages and oaths. In the modern context, this concept has been adapted on various digital platforms. On WhatsApp Status Updates, users often post messages or images that reflect their personal commitments, such as 'I promise to exercise every day' or 'I promise to call my mom every week.' On Instagram Reels, creators can showcase their talents or share their messages in a concise and engaging way, often using the term 'Kasam' to emphasize the importance of keeping promises. On Facebook, users might post updates or share content related to religious or cultural practices, using 'Kasam' as a hashtag or in the post title to signify their commitment to upholding those traditions.
